passage: Early efforts to control an invasive water plant on a large tropical lake relied on crews cutting it by hand. Only after officials released a beetle that feeds on the plant did the floating mats begin to shrink.

This widening inequality was visible in housing as well: new luxury apartments rose downtown even as families in older neighborhoods struggled to pay rent.

meaning: Able to substitute for one another
